features.name: log_content_length_norm
features.description: Log-scaled article body length normalized by the training-fold maximum token count.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear margin a bounded article-size axis and reduces influence of very long outliers.

features.name: lexical_uniqueness_z
features.description: Standardized unique-token ratio, clipped to limit extreme short-document effects.
features.expected_model_benefit: Centers vocabulary repetition versus variety on training-fold scale, enabling a near-linear style separation.

features.name: avg_token_length_z
features.description: Standardized average word length, clipped to a robust numeric interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures concise versus complex wording as a standardized style coordinate for linear/SVM margins.

features.name: link_density_log_norm
features.description: Log-scaled hyperlinks per 100 content tokens, saturated at a high-density reference level.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth normalized citation-intensity axis that can combine linearly with length and title semantics.

features.name: self_link_share
features.description: Fraction of hyperlinks that point internally, clipped to a valid share interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates internally navigational pieces from externally referenced pieces with a bounded ratio.

features.name: media_richness_norm
features.description: Log-scaled composite of images and videos, counting each video as two visual units.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes visual/video load into one continuous score, useful where presentation format differs by editorial area.

features.name: affect_valence_balance
features.description: Signed balance between upbeat and adverse word-rate signals, ratio-normalized by total affect-word rate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a signed affect direction that is already ratio-normalized, reducing need for nonlinear interactions.

features.name: subjective_sentiment_intensity_norm
features.description: Subjectivity-weighted absolute sentiment magnitude, normalized by training-fold extrema.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an emotional intensity dimension independent of sign, complementing the valence-balance feature.

features.name: title_public_affairs_focus_score
features.description: Numeric assessment from article_title only: 0.0 means no public-events emphasis; 1.0 means the title is mainly about government, elections, courts, policy, conflict, disasters, or international institutions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes high-cardinality title meaning as a smooth topical coordinate for the linear margin.

features.name: title_digital_platform_focus_score
features.description: Numeric assessment from article_title only: 0.0 means no digital-platform emphasis; 1.0 means the title is mainly about apps, gadgets, software, web platforms, online communities, memes, or viral web behavior.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a continuous semantic axis from sparse title cues around digital products and networked online activity.

features.name: title_commercial_finance_focus_score
features.description: Numeric assessment from article_title only: 0.0 means no commerce or finance emphasis; 1.0 means the title is mainly about companies, markets, money, jobs, startups, deals, or corporate decisions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a smooth economic-topic coordinate that a linear model can weight without sparse text expansion.

features.name: title_culture_living_focus_score
features.description: Numeric assessment from article_title only: 0.0 means no culture or everyday-living emphasis; 1.0 means the title is mainly about celebrities, TV, film, music, food, health, style, travel, family, relationships, or personal habits.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses broad human-interest title meaning into a bounded feature suitable for linear/SVM separation.
